content: Miɛ mi ne da umaŋ tĩɛnaana fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-teterre-na u bilaaya sɛbɛ naŋo u nadieŋga-na. Sɛbɛ faŋo‑i baa naa nyɛgɛ̃ŋ u yaaŋga-na baa u huoŋgu-na hiere aa pĩŋ-yo ŋaa figĩiŋgu aa nyaar-o sɔmma niehãi aa dãnya-mɛi.
naŋo piiye da gbagaga wuɔ: «Hai moloŋo‑i ka gbãa yer dãnyɔbaa daaba‑i halaŋ-ba aa puur sɛbɛ‑i?»
Molo saa da! Molo saa da dɔrɔ‑i-na, molo saa da hĩɛma-na, molo saa bi da kuoŋ-nelle-na duɔ puur sɛbɛ‑i a ne u huɔya-maama‑i.
Moloŋ uŋ'a u saa da dumaaŋo-na, miɛ pãŋ ta mi kaal higohigo!
Bĩncuɔŋ daaba‑i, unaŋo gbɛ̃-mi wuɔ: «Budii; baa kaal! Ne, jara maŋ hilaa *Yuda-baamba-na
, u yaraa u bigãarãamba‑i. *Davidi hãayɛ̃lŋo yaraa. U ka gbãa yer dãnyɔbaa daaba‑i aa puur sɛbɛ‑i.»

Miɛ mi ne da *Tũmbiloŋo naŋo yiɛraaya fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-teterre caaŋgu-na bimuɔmba naa-baaŋ daaba hɔlma-na, bĩncuɔmba yaaŋga-na. U taa u ne ŋaa ba cãa u nuoŋ-nu. U waa baa yiɛŋa niehãi baa yufieŋa niehãi. Yufieŋ daaya yaa Diiloŋ-Yalɛiŋa niehãi-waaŋa‑i
. U saaŋ a yaa‑i terni-na hiere hĩɛma-na.
Tũmbiloŋ wuɔ piɛ umaŋ tĩɛnaana fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-teterre-na a hũu sɛbɛ‑i u nadieŋga-na.

Bimuɔmba naa-baaŋ daaba‑i baa bĩncuɔmba komorre baa ba naa-baaŋ daa baa pãŋ sire dũuna Tũmbiloŋo yaaŋga-na. Ba waa baa koncoyieŋa ba yunniŋ hiere baa sɛ̃nɛ-biremmu. Bireŋ daamu naa yu baa wusũnaŋo. Wusũnaŋ daayo yaa pigãaŋ Diiloŋ-baamba cacãrãŋgu‑i.
Ba taa ba hãl nalãfɛliɛŋgu wuɔ:

content.text: ŋ ciɛ ŋ tãmma‑i a sãa nuɔmba yunni‑i terni-na hiere,
Nuɔnɛi gbãa biɛ sɛbɛ‑i a yer dãnyɔbaa-ba‑i aa puur-o.

content: Miɛ mi tiraa ne, a da dɔrpɔpuɔrbiemba‑i ŋaa sĩamba! Ba waa ŋaa nyɛiŋo; molo siɛ gbãa kãŋ-ba. Ba waa kalla bimuɔŋ daaba‑i baa bĩncuɔŋ daaba‑i baa fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-teter daade‑i hiere.
Ba taa ba hãl kabakaba wuɔ:
Diiloŋ uŋ hielaa bĩmbĩnni maŋ hiere, nimaŋ dɔrɔ‑i-na, baa nimaŋ hĩɛma-na, baa nimaŋ kuoŋ-nelle-na a naara nimaŋ hũmma-na, bĩmbĩnni‑i hiere miwaaŋo-na, miɛ nu ni hãl wuɔ:

content.text: bɔbɔima saaya ba yaa‑i, gbɛliɛma saaya ba yaa‑i,
fɔ̃ŋgũɔ saaya ba yaa‑i hɔnni maŋ joŋ!»

content: Bimuɔmba naa-baaŋ daa baa siɛ wuɔ: «Ma ciɛ.» Aa bĩncuɔŋ daa baa dũuna jaal-ba.

footnotes.text: Girɛkimma-na ba pigãaŋ *dɔrpɔpuɔrbiloŋ daayo sĩnni‑i wuɔ u waa baa fɔ̃ŋgũɔ ŋaa maŋ waaŋ dumaa 10.1.
Jara maŋ hilaa Yuda-baamba-na: Niɛŋ Miwaaŋo jĩnammaŋ-sɛbɛ‑i-na (Genèse) 49.9.
Diiloŋ-Yalɛiŋa niehãi: Niɛŋ 3.1 baa naaruɔ‑i cicaara‑i-na.
